name: public-agent-provisioning
description: A forkable template that provisions coding agents from maintained tools, with zero owned guard code. rulesync owns rules, community skills, hooks and MCP servers. gitleaks is the tool-call hook. Trunk owns the git guards. Vale owns prose. node:test proves each guard blocks a bad input and passes a good one.

scripts.verify: rulesync install --frozen && rulesync generate --check && trunk check --all && vale sync && vale . && node --test
